Verification costs almost nothing, which is why it can run on every applicant without mercy. Time is the toll no farm can skip: 23 minutes per proof, 6762 minutes for 294, due every single epoch. For every honest agent the dune is aged, the basalt is settled, and the pearl is long; for every farm the three are fresh, borrowed, and blank.
